description: This source file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions, focusing on validating URL parsing logic including scheme, authority, port, escape sequences, Unicode handling, and equivalence checks.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Tests whether a URL is considered normalizable.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Checks if the normalized URL matches the expected string.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Compares two URLs to determine if their normalized forms are equal or different.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if the URL normalization results in a URL with the expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL scheme normalization and validity.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit test for authority component normalization and validation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit test for port normalization and validation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Checks canonical form of URLs with various port representations.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization of URLs with percent-encoded characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization of URLs containing high-bit (non-ASCII) characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__utf8_escape(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization involving UTF-8 encoded characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Tests normalization of URLs with encoded username and password.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__length(void)
methods.description: Checks the length of normalized URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Tests URL normalization involving dot segments.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Tests equivalence of different URL representations after normalization.

ctags.name: check_url_normalizable
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/

ctags.signature: (const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
